description:
People will try to tell you what's realistic.
What's impossible.
What you can or cannot do.

Don't let someone else’s limits become your identity.

Be like the bumblebee. 🐝

📌 Save this as a reminder.
🔁 Share it with someone who's defying the odds.

💬 Where in your life do you need to be more like the bumblebee? 👇
transcript: When we were kids, my mom hung a poster over our bed. It had a picture of a bumblebee. And under the picture, the caption read, according to all aerodynamic laws, the bumblebee cannot fly because its body weight is not in the right proportion to its wingspan. But ignoring these laws, the bee flies anyway.
